title: Thin-liquidity overnight drop reversal: buy 08:00 UTC after sharp 00-08 UTC fall

source.title: Are There Any Simple Calendar Effects in Bitcoin Market?

rule_summary: Hourly candles, UTC clock. At the close of the 07:00-08:00 UTC bar compute d = close/open(00:00 UTC bar of the same day) - 1 (the overnight return over 8 bars). If d <= -1.5% and the last closed daily close is above the 100-day SMA of daily closes and no position is open, buy at the next bar open. Exit at the open of the 16:00 UTC bar the same day (when US hours are active), or earlier if a closed 1h bar is 3% below entry. One trade per day per pair. Daily trend filter is daily; others hourly.
mechanism: The source notes volume is lowest overnight and higher while US markets are open. Moves made in thin hours are less backed by real flow, so sellers who pushed price down through an empty book may be partly reversed when liquidity returns. This mechanism is the closest honest one, not stated by the source. The 0.35% round-trip cost needs a rebound well above that after a 1.5% drop, which fits only if reversals are sizeable. This is the opposite sign of idea 1, so it is a distinct test.
